prompt.text:
Implement a complete CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ createInventory }`. `createInventory(initialRecords)` creates an in-memory equipment inventory. Each initial record must be a non-array object with a nonempty trimmed string `id`, a nonempty trimmed string `label`, and an integer `quantity` greater than or equal to zero. IDs must be unique. Invalid input must throw `TypeError`; duplicate IDs must throw `Error("Duplicate id: <id>")`. Preserve insertion order.

The returned object must expose `list()`, `find(id)`, and `add(record)`. `list()` returns all records in insertion order. `find(id)` returns the matching record or `null`; a lookup ID is matched exactly and an invalid lookup returns `null`. `add(record)` validates and stores a new record, returning its normalized copy. Text fields are trimmed. All returned records must be fresh objects, and neither input nor output mutation may alter stored state. `initialRecords` must be an array; an empty array is valid.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
